NVIDIA CUDA compiled device math

The CUDA backend embeds PTX compiled from LogForge's own ColorKernel.cu with
NVIDIA NVRTC 12.8. The generated PTX includes compiled device math routines
from NVIDIA's compiler support library. NVIDIA retains its rights in those
portions; the LogForge MIT license does not relicense NVIDIA SDK components.

Use and redistribution of NVIDIA portions are subject to the NVIDIA CUDA
Toolkit Software License Agreement, including its redistribution requirements:
https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/12.8.1/eula/index.html

No NVIDIA driver, CUDA runtime DLL, NVRTC DLL, SDK headers, Toolkit installer,
or NVIDIA sample source code is bundled with the portable application.
The separately installed NVIDIA driver loads the embedded PTX. The GPU is
selected by runtime capability and numerical qualification, not a model list.

LogForge-authored C++ and CUDA source remain licensed under MIT. Developers
can rebuild the device artifact using their licensed CUDA compiler; the
source hash, PTX hash, compiler hash and exact options are recorded in
src/color/ColorKernel.manifest.json.

NVIDIA, CUDA and GeForce are trademarks of NVIDIA Corporation. LogForge is
independent and is not endorsed by NVIDIA Corporation.
